task.title: Docs: describe the tree in the Desktop Metaproject guide
task.description: Update docs/docs/guides/desktop-metaproject.md so it describes the sidebar tree shipped by T7: without a search the Graph list is a tree of folders and files (folders first with file counts, a module folder selectable as its module node: Enter or a click on the name selects it, Space or the chevron expands it), the Wiki list groups pages by page type ('domain-model' shown as 'Domain model', untyped pages under 'Other'); folders load on demand with Loading / error with Retry / Show more rows; keyboard (Up/Down, Left/Right, Home/End, Enter/Space); expanded folders survive leaving the explorer and switching Graph/Wiki; a selection made elsewhere expands its path, while the item shown by default on first open does not; with a search the list shows flat results as before; with an older Keryx CLI that does not offer the tree the list stays the flat catalog list and nothing fails; if the graph is not built the Graph tree says so. Fit it into the existing structure (most likely the 'Find a page, file, module or symbol' section and 'Recover from common problems'); match the guide's voice and do not restate unrelated sections. Read the code to confirm wording: apps/desktop/src/metaproject/MetaprojectTree.tsx and MetaprojectView.tsx. Then run `bun run docs:check` from the root and make it pass.

acceptance_criteria: AC9: The Desktop Metaproject guide describes the tree (Graph folders, Wiki groups, keyboard, behaviour with an older CLI) and the docs checks pass. [verify: exec `bun run docs:check`]
